pf_percent.message: Percentage of reads passing Illumina PF filtering. Low values can indicate run-level quality issues.

q30_percent.message: Percentage of PF bases with Q30 or better. This reflects confidence in base calls for downstream analysis.

mean_quality.message: Average Phred quality across cycles. Lower values indicate noisier reads and weaker sequencing confidence.

min_quality_post20.message: Minimum quality after cycle 20. Captures late-cycle degradation that can hurt alignment and methylation calls.

at_dropout.message: AT-rich region dropout. High values suggest uneven representation of AT-rich genomic content.

gc_dropout.message: GC-rich region dropout. High values suggest uneven representation of GC-rich genomic content.

median_insert_bp.message: Median insert size (bp). Out-of-range values can indicate library preparation or fragmentation issues.

deamination_qscore.message: Parabricks deamination qscore. In WGBS, lower scores are expected and reflect bisulfite conversion signal.

oxog_qscore.message: Parabricks OxoG qscore. Lower values indicate higher oxidative G>T damage risk.
